description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for editing port forwarding rules, including form handling, validation, and dynamic UI updates for IPv4 and IPv6 addresses in a network management system.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address into an array of its components, handling abbreviated '::' notation.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks if all input fields with specified prefix are blank, excluding specific fields.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates multiple input field values into a single address string with a specified separator.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address fields are required based on address input.

methods.name: ipv6_in_int
methods.description: Converts a segment of an IPv6 address into an integer array for comparison.

methods.name: isHex
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid hexadecimal number.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Compares two IPv6 address arrays to ensure the 'end' address is greater than or equal to the 'start' address.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Checks if IPv4 address input is necessary based on other inputs.
